summary: @servicetitan/forge 0.5.2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload unrelated to package purpose
details: package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style string-lookup wrappers hiding literals such as `ldd`, `/etc/os-release`, `bun`, and a GitHub release URL); it downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, chmods it executable, and invokes it (execFileSync) against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line obfuscated bundle with a rotating string-array decoder (functions `WV8StW`, string array `n7gIxM`) and a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header. The package advertises itself as a React UI component library (Alert, Button, Menu; `main:./forge.cjs`); none of the UI source imports or references `math_init.js`, and the library has no functional need for a Bun runtime. The obfuscated payload is reachable only through the preinstall + Bun path, so `npm install @servicetitan/forge@0.5.2` auto-executes attacker-controlled obfuscated code under a second language runtime that bypasses Node-based install-time inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
